purpose: Constrained claim-ID realization and local deterministic repair without semantic proposition inference.
integrity_boundaries: Inputs are bound to the maximal-supported diagnostic result by canonical SHA-256.
Only approved claim IDs, registered numeric slots, and required non-entailments can reach the final response.
Invalid clauses are removed locally; missing required content is reconstructed from public contracts.
This development component has not been frozen, independently validated, or used for confirmation.
